turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, Hale, and was Owen heard first?
If you escalate this, I'll make sure the academic integrity committee sees everything, including his two late assignments from September.
"If you escalate this." I'm writing that down. There's no committee in the procedure I printed, and late assignments aren't evidence, so what do you have on the essay?
No, yours. Show me a document or take the zero off.
